_comment: Domain rules for the architectural-memory symbol index. First match wins. Most-specific patterns first; broad catch-alls last. Domains must match /^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,49}$/.

rules._why: MUST precede the scripts/check-*.mjs catch-all (first-match-wins). That glob assigns every check-* CLI to `install`, which swallowed this one — a plan-status checker, not installation logic — and manufactured a recurring install -> plan violation out of a naming coincidence. The code was right; the map was wrong. Other check-* CLIs are likely miscategorised too (check-rls is security, check-stale-skill-surface is skills); retagged only the one with an observed violation rather than reshuffling the whole glob blind.

rules._comment: Phase A (domain-map-reconciliation): these subsystems each own a scripts/lib/<name>/ directory and a top-level CLI, and were silently pooled into the shared-lib catch-all below because no rule claimed them (70 of shared-lib's 156 files). shared-lib is the SECOND-TO-LAST rule — anything added under scripts/lib/ without a rule here lands in it and its deps get attributed to 'shared-lib', which is how shared-lib came to appear to import 9 feature domains. When you add a new scripts/lib/<subsystem>/, add a rule here too; tests/domain-map-dead-intent.test.mjs cannot catch this (the rule isn't dead — it's absent).

_comment_purposes: Outcome/purpose taxonomy + domain->purpose edges for the dashboard Purpose tab (docs/plans/dashboard-purpose-view.md). purposes: curated outcome nodes (7); kind=skill-chain when backed by flows.json node ids, else curated. domainPurposes: manual domain->purpose edges; a domain may serve several purposes (rendered with an 'also serves N' badge). Unmapped domains + domains absent from the architecture map surface as hygiene warnings in the tab.

_comment_codeless: Domains that are code-less BY DESIGN (markdown / SQL / SKILL.md-only) — they have no JS symbols, so they will never appear in the code-symbol architecture map. The Purpose-tab hygiene treats a mapped-but-no-arch domain in this list as INFORMATIONAL (a neutral note), not an actionable 'stale rule' warning. Only add a domain here once you've confirmed it genuinely has no indexable code (vs a dead/mis-targeted rule that should be fixed instead).
_comment_allowedDeps: BASELINE, NOT ENDORSEMENT (domain-map-reconciliation Phase C, 2026-07-17). Set to the OBSERVED graph AFTER Phase A fixed rule coverage (13 orphaned lib subsystems) and the file-lock move removed the false trapped-primitive edges — so these are real edges, not measurement artifacts. This makes the violation check a RATCHET: it cannot fail on what exists today, only on NEW undeclared edges. THREE entries are recorded debt, NOT intent: (1) shared-lib -> audit-orchestration/claude-hooks/model-eval/nav-audit/stores — ~6 top-level lib files (efficacy-lints, config, repo-inventory, audit-shadow, finalize-outcomes, audit-arms) are feature coordinators, not domain-neutral primitives; retag or move them. (2) stores -> model-eval/persona-test — a LAYER INVERSION: the persistence layer reaching UP into feature domains. (3) cross-skill-bridge -> 11 domains — AGENTS.md calls this a thin facade; eleven deps is not thin. Do not grow these three without fixing the underlying coupling. ADDENDUM (tech-debt-backlog-triage, 2026-07-26): root-scripts -> install added — install.mjs/setup.mjs (repo-root entry points, caught by the *.mjs catch-all) import scripts/lib/install/prompt.mjs; same entry-point-to-implementation shape already declared for `scripts`, just never extended to the two root-level installers. Closes tech-debt topicIds 0fd83d0f/99f61113/a122a79b/d9f8c219.

_adjudication_2026_07_31_acceptance_back._context: Companion to _adjudication_2026_07_31 (which covers the layering pass). These three edges surfaced while clearing the unremediated-acceptance backlog: 11 [Architecture] findings across 6 runs. Two verdicts are POINTERS to decisions already taken — the decision existed, only the remediation_state write-back was missing, which is exactly why the pass kept re-raising them.
_adjudication_2026_07_31_acceptance_back.setup.mjs -> install: DECLARED 2026-07-26 — see the ADDENDUM in _comment_allowedDeps. Re-raised 5 more times because no remediation_state was written, so unremediated_acceptances kept listing it. Write-back done 2026-07-31 citing 3a2530ae. (The install.mjs half of this edge was instead RE-TAGGED by the layering pass — see L4 in _adjudication_2026_07_31 — so those 3 findings cite d1d8097c.) Tempted to move scripts/lib/install/prompt.mjs to shared-lib because it is a generic readline wrapper with no install-domain logic? That is a reasonable reading, but it second-guesses a call already taken on the entry-point-to-implementation shape. Reopen deliberately or not at all.
_adjudication_2026_07_31_acceptance_back.stores -> plan: NOT REPRODUCIBLE, CAUSE UNATTRIBUTED. plans-ship.mjs imports ../status-vocabulary.mjs, which resolves to shared-lib via scripts/lib/**, and stores -> shared-lib is allowed. Deliberately NOT written back as fixed: d1d8097c did not touch that file import lines, so the edge may have gone via a domain-map RETAG rather than a code change (the MAP ERROR class from 2026-07-20), and fix_commit_sha would be a misattribution. An unattributed disappearance is not evidence of a fix.
_adjudication_2026_07_31_acceptance_back.shared-lib -> audit-orchestration: RECORDED DEBT, NOT INTENT — must keep firing. config.mjs imports cycle/topology.mjs (PREVIEW_GATE_MODES) and efficacy-lints.mjs imports audit/glob-match.mjs; both real. _comment_allowedDeps entry (1) already names this as one of THREE debts with the fix stated (feature coordinators masquerading as domain-neutral primitives; retag or move them) and says not to grow them without fixing the coupling. DO NOT silence the recurring finding by adding an allowedDeps entry — converting a documented debt into a false declaration of intent is the one move this block exists to prevent.

_adjudication_2026_07_20._context: Four domain edges were reported by /audit-code's architecture pass in NINE consecutive rounds across two clusters (plan: sast-triage-routing). Adjudicated once, on the merits, so they stop consuming a finding slot every round.
_adjudication_2026_07_20.install -> plan: MAP ERROR, not a code defect. check-plan-status.mjs was swallowed by the scripts/check-*.mjs catch-all and tagged `install`. Fixed by a specific rule ahead of it; the edge is now plan -> plan (same-domain, always allowed). See that rule's _why.
_adjudication_2026_07_20.dashboard -> plan: INTENT — DECLARED. collect-reference.mjs calls parsePlanStatus to bucket plans by status. A dashboard is a read-model consumer by construction (it already draws on eight domains), so this is its established role, not erosion.
_adjudication_2026_07_20.brainstorm -> requirements: INTENT — DECLARED. policy-context.mjs's own docstring records this as a REUSE decision taken under the architectural-memory protocol rather than reimplementing ledger filtering. NOTE: declaring it CLOSES A CYCLE, because requirements -> brainstorm already exists. That is recorded as debt (4) rather than hidden by the declaration.
_adjudication_2026_07_20.supabase -> stores: FABRICATED, now FIXED IN CODE (2026-07-20). The edge came from `compat-bootstrap.sql` doing `CREATE SCHEMA auth; CREATE TABLE auth.users` (a parity shim for what Supabase provides natively), so every migration's `REFERENCES auth.users(id)` resolved to that file — a `supabase → stores` edge that reflects a PLATFORM dependency, not a real one on the shim. The earlier note said 'nothing to fix in code or map', but leaving it meant the mechanical adapter re-fabricated it every run and the bouncer kept hallucinating findings off it (32 accumulated). Fixed by `PLATFORM_SCHEMAS` in adapters/postgres.mjs: a reference to `auth.*` (and the other Supabase-managed schemas) is `proven-external`, like `pg_*`, so no local edge is created even when a shim defines a copy. Verified: runArchIntentAnalysis now reports 0 violations. Guard: tests/arch-intent-adapter-postgres.test.mjs.
_adjudication_2026_07_20._debt_4: requirements -> brainstorm exists only because requirements/{extract,gap-challenge}.mjs import callOpenAI from brainstorm/openai-adapter.mjs — a domain-NEUTRAL LLM primitive that happens to live inside the brainstorm domain. Same misplacement class as debt (1). Moving it to shared-lib breaks the cycle and touches ~5 real call sites; that is a mechanical module move deserving its own change and its own verification, not a rider on a map adjudication.

_comment_tests: tests is a VERIFICATION domain: allowed one-way into everything, with the inverse PROHIBITED — no production domain may import tests (enforced by the absence of `tests` from every other allowedDeps entry; a violation surfaces as an undeclared edge). This entry was UNVERIFIABLE until 2026-07-17: extract.mjs handed dep-cruiser a COMMON_SOURCE_DIRS allowlist with no `tests`, so the largest domain in the repo (380 files) produced zero observed edges while being fully symbol-indexed — the 12 entries here were hand-written from real knowledge but could never be corroborated. With `tests` cruised, all 12 proved real (zero over-declaration) and 17 more appeared. See docs/plans/observed-graph-discovery-unification.md — the allowlist remains a silent-blindness generator; this fixed the instance, not the class.
_comment_coverage: Observed-graph coverage contract (docs/plans/observed-graph-coverage-honesty.md 2.1.4). floor/attributionFloor are ratios in [0,1]; maxCruiseMs is the SOFT budget (degraded), hardTimeoutMs the parent-enforced kill. enforce:false ships first — arch:coverage-gate reports the verdict without failing for one cycle of real data. attributionFloor is deliberately low: an untagged domain is a domain-map gap, not a correctness bug; the load-bearing guard is the zero_attributed vacuity check, not this ratio.
_adjudication_2026_08_01: Layering pass L5 (docs/plans/dashboard-skills-index-layering.md). dashboard -> scripts REFACTORED AWAY, not declared — and the pre-existing declaration was REMOVED. scripts/lib/dashboard/collect-reference.mjs imported loadAllSkills from scripts/skills-help.mjs, a top-level CLI entry point; the two pure functions (parseSkill, loadAllSkills) moved verbatim to scripts/lib/skills-index.mjs (shared-lib), which dashboard already declares — so the fix added ZERO edges and deleted one grant. Why removal rather than accept-by-declaration: "scripts" was NOT an adjudication. It entered allowedDeps.dashboard on 2026-07-17 in the Phase-C baseline that set allowedDeps to the OBSERVED graph wholesale (see _comment_allowedDeps, which opens "BASELINE, NOT ENDORSEMENT"), which is AFTER the three findings it appeared to bless were raised (2026-07-15/15/16). Affirming it would have converted a mechanical snapshot into recorded intent the map explicitly disclaims. Same reasoning as the L4 RE-TAG decision in _adjudication_2026_07_31, and stronger here: skills-help.mjs was the SOLE producer of the edge (the only other ../../ import under scripts/lib/dashboard/** is audit-metrics.mjs, which tags audit-orchestration and is separately declared), so the grant covered exactly one import of one function while granting the whole current and future root-scripts domain. NO new rule was added: skills-index.mjs is a FILE, not a scripts/lib/<subsystem>/ directory, so it correctly falls through the scripts/lib/** -> shared-lib catch-all. Guards: tests/layering-contracts.test.mjs L5 (module resolves to shared-lib; the moved symbols are absent from BOTH skills-help.mjs's namespace and its __test__ object; "scripts" is absent from allowedDeps.dashboard — nothing else checks for a stale allowedDeps EDGE, since computeDeadIntent only finds dead DOMAINS) and tests/dashboard-collect-reference.test.mjs (first coverage of the consumer path). Closes tech-debt topicIds 7cd98d98/dafaf6c8/1f6dd42d.
_adjudication_2026_07_31: Layering pass (docs/plans/layering-and-mutation-contracts.md). L2 DECLARED: cross-skill-bridge -> model-eval. cross-skill.mjs is the CLI facade and already declares dispatch edges to arm-eval, audit-orchestration, nav-audit, persona-test and stores; model-eval was an omission in the intent layer, not a violation. L4 RE-TAGGED (not declared): install.mjs -> install. It was root-scripts only via the '*.mjs' catch-all, while its sibling scripts/install-skills.mjs was already 'install'. Declaring tests -> root-scripts would have granted every test module access to the whole current and future root-scripts domain to express one narrow relationship; re-tagging removes the edge instead. L1 and L3 were REFACTORED, not declared: CoverageSchema -> lib/coverage-schema.mjs and canonicaliseForHash -> lib/canonical-hash.mjs (both shared-lib), old exports removed.
